Sub FindPasswords()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim foundCell As Range
    Dim outputRow As Long
    
    ' Set the worksheet to search (ActiveSheet)
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    
    ' Set up the list on a new sheet called "Log"
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Sheets("Log").Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    Sheets.Add(After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)).Name = "Log"
    outputRow = 1
    
    ' Add headers to the log sheet
    Sheets("Log").Cells(outputRow, 1).Value = "Cell Address"
    Sheets("Log").Cells(outputRow, 2).Value = "Content"
    outputRow = outputRow + 1
    
    ' Search the entire used range of the worksheet
    With ws.Cells
        Set foundCell = .Find(What:="password", LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, SearchDirection:=xlNext, MatchCase:=False)
        
        Do While Not foundCell Is Nothing
            ' Write the address and the content to the log sheet

            Sheets("Log").Cells(outputRow, 2).Value = foundCell.Value
            outputRow = outputRow + 1
